answer_1.quote: Thus, empathetic response generation task has been considered noteworthy ... We conduct experiments on EmpatheticDialogues.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the models, using the following three metrics: (1) Perplexity (PPL) ... (2) Distinct-n (Dist-n) ... (3). We use BERTscore (F BERT) which measures token-level semantic similarities ...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluations for the dialogues models are essential ... we randomly sampled 100 test dialogues and asked 3 human workers to score models' generated responses on 1 to 5 point scale, following the four metrics: (1) Empathy ... (2) Relevance ... (3) Fluency ... (4) Diversity.
answer_4.guideline: Score each response on a 1‑5 scale for Empathy, Relevance, Fluency, and Diversity.
